name: Bid for Anime!
desc:
🎌 Welcome to Bid For Anime!

Join crazy auction duels, bid your cash, and collect the rarest Anime Characters!

✅ How to Play:

🏦 Join an auction table
💰 Bid against another player
⚔️ Win Anime Characters and add them to your collection
📈 Earn money from your Anime collection
🍀 Upgrade your luck to roll rarer characters
🌟 Hunt for Golden, Diamond, Galaxy, and RAINBOW variants
🔄 Rebirth to earn legendary titles — from Extra to Final Boss
🎁 Gift passes to your friends

Can you outbid everyone and build the ultimate Anime collection?

Leave a like and join our group for a FREE +50% Luck boost! ❤️
